CRIT-KOLAM-CONTINUITY.drill_hint: Practise one stage in a single motion, keeping the pen down through the crossings.
CRIT-KOLAM-CONTINUITY.why_it_matters: The figure is 1 unbroken line with no loose ends (CLM-05), so it can be drawn without lifting the hand.

CRIT-KOLAM-COVERAGE.drill_hint: Trace the faint goal line once, stage by stage, then redraw from memory.
CRIT-KOLAM-COVERAGE.why_it_matters: The finished pattern is made of 1 continuous line through the dots (CLM-02); a missing section leaves the figure open.

CRIT-KOLAM-CURVES.drill_hint: Repeat the stage where the line stopped until it joins the next stage.
CRIT-KOLAM-CURVES.why_it_matters: Each of the 1 line closes on itself (CLM-02); an unfinished line breaks the loop.

CRIT-KOLAM-DOTS.drill_hint: Draw only the segment between two neighbouring dots, aiming straight through each dot.
CRIT-KOLAM-DOTS.why_it_matters: The dots fix the geometry: 40 of 41 lie on the line (CLM-04) out of the dot grid (CLM-01).

CRIT-KOLAM-PRECISION.drill_hint: Slow down at crossings and dots; keep the line inside the faint band.
CRIT-KOLAM-PRECISION.why_it_matters: The target has no loose ends or stray marks (CLM-05); in a powder kolam a stray line cannot be erased.
